review_text: Recent updates have introduced a bunch of bugs that make it really inconvenient to use daily. The grid view has random large or elongated photos making it hard to scan photos and follow their chronological order. The edit tools randomly switch order, making it take longer to find specific tools. Select and drag is completely bugged, making it tedious to select more than one photo. Really disappointing, as this was one of the most polished Google apps but is now buggy and a chore to use.

After a decade, I'm having to shop around for an alternate gallery/editing app. UI navigation is so much worse than ever before. Features are harder to find--the opposite of intuitive. Generative AI is fun, but it is not a replacement for editing an original photo, yet basic editing features are harder to access and tell when they are applied. And SO buggy. Random changes do not apply if they're not done before certain other changes. I'm sick of being an involuntary beta tester, Google.

Once loved this for photo storing and basic manipulation, but the updates are terrible for any kind of photo editing. Cropping now showing curved corners instead of straight, pushy AI, and the inability to work in landscape mode are all huge downgrades. Update July 2026- now even browsing your pictures, the UI is covered with needless floating menus and mismatched image sizes making it hard to find pictures. 50% of my images are covered with black bubbles while scrolling

Overall, it's good. The only thing I don't like is that there should be an option to detect or find duplicate photos, because sometimes it contains a lot of duplicate photos. Adding this feature would make it much easier to organize and clean up the gallery.

Google Photos is simply the best photo management app I've ever used. The backup is fast and reliable, the search is incredibly accurate, and the AI-powered features make organizing memories effortless. I love how easy it is to find old photos, free up storage, and keep everything securely synced across devices. The interface is clean, smooth, and user-friendly. A truly world-class app that keeps getting better with every update. Highly recommended!

This app has become completely unusable after recent updates. The battery drain is insane—my phone gets hot and loses percentage rapidly even when I am barely browsing my photos. On top of that, the performance is terrible. Animations are choppy, laggy, and frame-dropping constantly, making basic scrolling feel frustratingly slow. To make matters worse, the whole user interface is a cluttered mess—finding simple local device folders or settings has become overly complex and confusing.
